name: Determinant of 2x2 Matrix
description: Replaced the seed's 3x3 sparse matrix and its max-eigenvalue condition with a 2x2 dense matrix and a determinant condition. The new condition $\det(S) = -5$ evaluates to true if and only if the modes are different, preserving the exact same bipartiteness logic while destroying the specific surface patterns (like $\sqrt{5}$ and the star matrix structure) that models rely on to skip reasoning.
